Randers FC is a professional football club based in Randers, East Jutland, that plays in the Danish Superliga, the top flight of the Danish football league system. Founded on 1 January 2003, the club builds upon the license of Randers Freja, a former three-time Danish Cup winning team. As of 2022 the club has won the Danish Cup twice in its history. Randers plays its matches at the 10,300-capacity Cepheus Park Randers.
